name: anki-break
description: Turns waiting for Claude into flashcard time. On macOS, Anki opens when Claude has been working for a few seconds, and you switch back to Claude when it is done or needs you.

delay_seconds.title: Seconds before Anki opens
delay_seconds.description: How long Claude must be working before Anki opens, from 0 to 600. Short answers then never open Anki. Default 10.

when_done.title: When Claude is done
when_done.description: Type keep to switch back to Claude and leave Anki running in the background (default), or quit to also close Anki when Claude is done (only an Anki that Anki-Break opened).
